title: Final Energy Shift 1s
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy shift of the 1s state, E'_{10} = 2e^2 r_p^2 / (5a^3).

title: Final Energy Shift 2p
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy shift of the 2p state, E'_{21} = e^2 r_p^4 / (1120a^5).

title: Coulomb Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the correct form of the Coulomb potential energy for both regions (inside and outside the proton).

title: Hamiltonian Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the Hamiltonian, including both the unperturbed and perturbation terms.

title: Integration Process
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct integration process for calculating the energy shifts using the radial wave functions.

title: Continuity Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the continuity condition at r = r_p to find the constant C in the potential energy.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the expressions for potential energy or energy shifts.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the approximation e^{-r/a} ≈ 1 for r_p << a.
